claims.text: Mauhúr was sent to reinforce Uglúk's troop as they returned to Isengard with Merry and Pippin. He found them surrounded by Éomer's Rohirrim at the edge of Fangorn Forest, from which he led his Orcs in an attack. This attack was a failure: the Rohirrim were able to defeat the Orcs, even with Mauhúr's reinforcements. It is unknown whether Mauhúr and his soldiers were "killed or driven off" by the Rohirrim.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Two Towers, "The Uruk-hai"
